sentences.en: Can you secure me two good seats for the concert?
sentences.zh: 你能给我弄两张音乐会的好票吗？

sentences.en: They strengthened the embankments to secure the village against floods.
sentences.zh: 他们加固了堤坝以防止洪水侵袭村庄。

sentences.en: It is necessary to secure financing for local road maintenance.
sentences.zh: 必须为地方道路维护筹集资金。
